title: Paynter lands at the wrong airport on the way to Chico
summary: John Harrington tells of Paynter lands at the wrong airport on the way to Chico, about c. 1974 at Near Chico, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Painter has landed at the wrong airport.

plain: A man named John Harrington, speaking on a podcast episode about a former US Secretary of Energy, says that around 1974 he was there when a man named Bill Paynter, flying toward Chico, California, landed at the wrong airport. He tells it as a first-hand moment from that trip.
